headline: Jullundur Motor Agency confirms SEBI-compliant demat processing for Q3 2026
summary: Jullundur Motor Agency has confirmed that its demat processing will be fully SEBI-compliant for the third quarter of 2026. The procedural update ensures adherence to regulatory standards for shareholder record-keeping and electronic transfers. For Indian retail investors, this administrative update ensures smooth share settlement without direct financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory compliance ensures smooth share settlement.
